query: shadcn/ui Base UI default changelog 2026 Radix
facts: July 2026 changelog: Base UI is the default component library in shadcn/ui
New projects default to Base UI: `npx shadcn init` picks Base UI
Radix is NOT deprecated; it remains supported
every update and new component ships for BOTH libraries (unless a component only exists in Base UI)
no migration is required for existing projects
Radix is one flag away for new projects: add `-b radix` for scripts/CI expecting Radix
docs default to the Base UI tab; Radix docs are one click away
rationale: shadcn/create users were already picking Base UI over Radix 2 to 1
history: shadcn/ui launched Jan 2023 on Radix; the same team later began building Base UI
migration tooling shipped as an agent skill (not a codemod); test project of 60+ components (36 on Radix) migrated in ~25 min, ~10k tokens per component
July 2026 React Aria release: Base UI remains the default, Radix remains fully supported, existing projects stay on their current base; React Aria selectable in CLI/presets/shadcn-create
